name: Declan Murphy
bio:
Declan's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by his father's involvement in rallying. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at Trinity College Dublin, specializing in aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he joined a small Formula Ford team, quickly rising through the ranks to become their lead engineer. His meticulous approach and knack for identifying crucial performance gains led to several podium finishes and attracted the attention of larger teams. 

Declan believes in a data-driven approach to technical development, emphasizing rigorous testing and simulation. He's known for his ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable instructions for his team. He's particularly skilled at identifying innovative solutions within existing regulations, often finding subtle advantages that others overlook. His collaborative spirit and calm demeanor make him a valuable asset in high-pressure environments.

Now seeking new challenges, Declan is eager to apply his expertise to a team with ambitions for championship success. He's particularly drawn to organizations that foster a culture of continuous improvement and value the contributions of every team member.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, with a slight wave
physical.description: Declan is of average height, with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a daily cup of strong Irish tea, brewed precisely.
